profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under the ticker TDC. On its own website, Teradata describes itself as "the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment." It says its Autonomous Knowledge Platform is meant to make AI "real, trusted, governed, and built to scale," and it points to a product and service portfolio for AI, analytics, and cloud solutions. The company also says it partners with other providers to deliver technology and AI-driven resources.

The site material does not name specific products, executives, or partners, and no products are tracked in the company record. The record lists no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company. It does note a law exposure count of 281 in California, the state where the company is headquartered.
